title: Provider-authorized worker results must retain the provider disclosure label
mechanism: The previous one-way check rejected provider-labelled results without consent but accepted local/unknown labels after an authorized provider request. The UI local disclosure could therefore falsely deny a query. This is malformed-worker-result validation; the demonstrated request was authorized, and the test does not show that Esplora alone can forge a worker completion.
fix: Reject when (spentStatus === provider) differs from the request consent boolean. Default-off results may remain local or unknown; opted-in successful results must be provider. Existing worker termination and tweak wiping handle invalid completions.
